data_code:
import pandas as pd

df_dt = pd.read_excel('data/downtime.xlsx', sheet_name='정지이력')
df_rl = pd.read_excel('data/run_log.xlsx', sheet_name='주간요약')

df_dt['일자'] = pd.to_datetime(df_dt['일자'])
start_date = pd.Timestamp('2026-03-02')
df_dt['주차'] = ((df_dt['일자'] - start_date).dt.days // 7) + 1

dt_weekly = df_dt.groupby('주차')['정지시간(분)'].sum().reset_index()
dt_weekly['총정지시간(h)'] = dt_weekly['정지시간(분)'] / 60

df_rl['주차'] = pd.to_numeric(df_rl['주차'], errors='coerce').dropna().astype(int)
prod_weekly = df_rl[['주차', '총생산량(kg)']].rename(columns={'총생산량(kg)': '총생산량'})

merged = pd.merge(dt_weekly[['주차', '총정지시간(h)']], prod_weekly, on='주차', how='inner')
df = merged
title: 주차별 총 정지시간 vs 총생산량 상관관계
